name: Rilu Rilu Fairilu Kirakira: Hajimete no Fairilu Magic
summary: Become a fairylu (fairy) and live together with Rippu and other fairy friends in their village. Play minigames, decorate your home, coordinate outfits and use magic to help and support your friends and become the perfect fairylu resident!
